author: Blueberry Tribes team
description: Example phase-1 mod: the Green Valley map (40x32) replaces the custom level q=11 ('plot of land'). No repack needed — drop this folder into <exe>\mods\ and the game loads the map from it. The map JSON is the same Green Valley proven by the J2ME repack proof (byte-for-byte RLE round-trip, played in freej2me); only format_version and slot_q were added for v0.2.
name: Green Valley
